newsitem.title: USA: United Auto names Marshall Cogan chair/CEO.
newsitem.headline: United Auto names Marshall Cogan chair/CEO.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Friday its board named Marshall Cogan chairman and chief executive officer, effective April 17.
Cogan is the company's founder, vice chairman and chairman of the executive committee.
Cogan succeeds Carl Spielvogel, who resigned as chairman and CEO, a position he held since 1994. Spielvogel will not stand for reelection as a director.
The company said Spielvogel has a contract that ends December 31, 2000 and he will continue as a consultant for United Auto until then.

The company is continuing its search for an automotive retailing executive to fill the position of president and chief operating officer. It said it retained Korn Ferry International to identify candidates for the position.
